question.text: Himalaya Arbitrage Fund (Cat III AIF) wants to onboard (i) an external individual investor and (ii) an employee of the Investment Manager. What are the minimum investment amounts applicable?

answer.text: External: INR 25 lakh; Employee: INR 25 lakh
External: INR 1 crore; Employee: INR 25 lakh
External: INR 1 crore; Employee: INR 1 crore
External: INR 25 crore (LVF); Employee: INR 1 crore

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Minimum investment by external investor in an AIF is INR 1 crore (non-AI). For employees/directors of the AIF or Investment Manager participating in individual capacity, the minimum is INR 25 lakh. AIs are exempted from the INR 1 cr floor; LVF requires INR 25 cr per AI investor. **The Trap:** Option A incorrectly lowers the external floor. Option C ignores the employee concession. Option D applies LVF minimum which isn't asked. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C/D/B all test this. XIX-E cares because employee subscriptions must be tracked under PIT (insider-trading) rules too. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** For open-ended Cat III, first lump sum must be ≥ INR 1 cr; additional contributions have no floor. Partial redemptions must leave the investor above INR 1 cr.
